description: `(randomize 1 2)` — the `randomize` command takes at most one seed argument; a second raises `ol-too-many-inputs` (`spec/commands.md`'s `randomize` entry, issue #287), same arity-diagnostic convention every other command uses. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
